C1229.title: Alibaba Fined 18.228 Billion Yuan for "Either-Or" Monopolistic Practices
C1229.summary: On April 10, 2021, the State Administration for Market Regulation imposed an administrative penalty on Alibaba Group for its "either-or" monopolistic practices, ordering it to cease illegal activities and fining it 4% of its 2019 domestic sales revenue in China, totaling 18.228 billion yuan.
